description: Charcoal drawing of two distinct dark lines that run down the center of the paper. Peeping out of these lines are two small dark half spheres, as if emerging from behind curtains, located in the upper center of the painting.  These are the darkest of the entire composition, touched with highlights that suggest a full roundness to them.
